subject: Re: N-Grammer kickoff — staffing plan
body:
Priya,

Staffing, with the July crunch in mind:

- Gustavo: C4/SuperGLUE reproduction now, then the FLOP study. 80% through June.
- Rosa: training-stack integration and benchmark plumbing, 50%.
- Rafael Duran: committed at 60% to N-Grammer for July 2026 to lead the flax/haiku API release — he wrote our internal Jax API guidelines, so the mid-July library milestone is his to land. Before July he's advisory at ~15% while Gustavo runs the repro.

You're right that the team is popular, so I've written those numbers into the resourcing sheet — July especially is load-bearing: if Rafael's allocation slips, the API release moves to August past your window.

Compute: repro and FLOP study fit titan-a100 best-effort; the C4 runs are the big line but they serialize fine. No reservation ask.

Daniela
